title: Synthetic Data Generation for Healthcare Analysis using GANs
summary: A project that trains CTGAN, TVAE, and Gaussian Copula synthesizers on COVID-19 and cardiovascular risk factor healthcare datasets, evaluates the synthetic data quality, and trains a Random Forest classifier with SHAP interpretability on the results. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer along with its diagnostic and quality report evaluation utilities to generate and assess synthetic healthcare data.
evidence: Synthetic_data_main.py:83-140 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fits and samples them; run_diagnostic/evaluate_quality also called.
